biggest_catch: The account must remain open for a minimum of 6 months or the bonus is forfeited, and the $400 requires a recurring direct deposit of at least $400/month for three full months before you even qualify — plus Digital Banking and eStatements enrollment within 120 days (skip eStatements and your account is defaulted to Personal Checking).
catches: $400 offer applies to NEW eChecking accounts for NEW Temecula-Murrieta members only — a branch-specific promo, not the general California Credit Union offer.
Minimum $25 required to open the account.
Enroll in Digital Banking within 120 days of account opening.
Establish a recurring Direct Deposit (Direct Deposit or Payroll Deposit) with a minimum of $400 per month within 120 days of membership opening.
Three (3) months of recurring direct deposits must be credited to the account before you qualify for the bonus.
Enroll in eStatements within 120 days of account opening; if not completed, the account defaults to Personal Checking without notice.
The bonus is added to the checking account the first week of the month following the qualifying date and will be reported as income.
Bonus is forfeited if the account does not remain open for a minimum of 6 months.
The eChecking account does not accrue dividends.
Account and membership are subject to approval; a Share Account with $0.01 par value is required to establish membership.
Programs and offers may change without notice; no explicit offer expiry was found on the official page.

steps: Become a new member of the California Credit Union Temecula-Murrieta Branch and open a new eChecking account (minimum $25 opening deposit).
Enroll in Digital Banking within 120 days of account opening.
Establish a recurring direct deposit (Direct Deposit or Payroll Deposit) of at least $400 per month within 120 days of membership opening.
Receive three (3) months of recurring direct deposits credited to the account.
Enroll in eStatements within 120 days of account opening (otherwise the account defaults to Personal Checking).
The $400 bonus is added the first week of the month after the qualifying date; keep the account open at least 6 months or the bonus is forfeited. The bonus is reported as income.
